technical-summary: RUM09 matched 3-pair Flash-Next 4-GPU comparison, Radiance 2.2 candidate (7c6737638) vs 1170.35.0, policy off, identical prompts and token counts per pair: decode step -5 to -6.5% (better), long7 prefill +1.7%, cold TTFT -0.3%; gate FAIL on prefill.long8_prefill_tps -2.75% and prefill.doc_prefill_tps -0.34%. A 10-launch chained-launch on/off A/B (bigcherry-2) clears chaining: the candidate's long-8 TTFT is bimodal (about 102 s or 104.5-105 s) in both arms; doc prefill unaffected. Parity run records now carry the hash of the executable actually measured (27da42525). Owner re-scope: the bump carries every serving config (RUM09 acceptance, RUM06 a blocker); single native YAML per config with an x-bigcherry section designed with a full key mapping (RUM04). TP3 27B start on 2.2 found: rank-devices engine/owner mismatch on mixed-arch worlds (rad0009) and a missing plain E4M3 page16 fused KV store for Qwen 27B (RUM11).
user-summary-candidate: Radiance 2.2 measured against the current release: decode about 5-6% faster, a small long-prompt prefill regression still under investigation; the bump now carries every serving config and gaps for the Qwen 27B TP3 configs are found and planned.
